At Okanagan Graveller, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on okanagan mountain gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Okanagan Graveller. Train it until it feels boring.
74 miles on okanagan mountain gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Okanagan Graveller’s 74 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Okanagan Graveller requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on okanagan mountain gravel to build confidence. Expect: forest service roads, sustained mountain climbs, rugged gravel.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 74 miles of okanagan mountain gravel in West Kelowna, British Columbia, Canada.
